title: Setup → Users on a managed environment: add-person and CSV-import UI with per-row invitation status (reverses objectui#13330 for adding)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ④ a child of the topic card objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (the maintainer's rulings 1-10 of 2026-11-13/14 are recorded there; read it first). 

## 维护者速读

「设置 → 用户」的加人界面：可以一个个加，也可以导入 CSV；每一行显示邀请状态（待发送、已发送、已接受、失败及原因，例如开发者版人数已满）；可以重发邀请，删除待激活的人时会同时取消邀请。

## Work (objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 child 1c)
- The UI for card F2's door, including per-row invitation status from the host seam.
- Re-send and delete. Deleting a pending row cancels its invitation, which covers the email-typo case.
- CSV partial failures are shown row by row.
- Reverses objectui#13330 for adding only. Password actions stay hidden.

Routing: triage (`domain:ui`).

Blocked-by: #33181

`priority:p1` on the maintainer's word, verbatim (seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`, 2026-11-14): 「都是p1，车道自己认领就可以」. Triage routes it to its lane; the lane claims it.
